## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Sangamam hold?
Sangamam's hall accommodates up to 200 guests, with a separate dining hall.

### Where is Sangamam?
No. 93 Bazaar Road, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091.

### What facilities does Sangamam have?
Fully air-conditioned, Automated lift, In-house pure-veg catering, Separate dining hall, Ample & valet parking, Custom seating, Event management support.

### Is the catering vegetarian?
Yes, catering is in-house and pure vegetarian.
